title: OneWater Marine Inc. Announces Fiscal Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Driving Margin Expansion and Strengthening Balance Sheet Fiscal Second Quarter 2026 Highlights Revenue decreased 9% to $442 million Same-store sales decreased 8% Gross profit margin of 23.9% increased 110 bps GAAP net loss of $(13) million, or $(0.78) per diluted share; adjusted diluted loss per share 1 was $(0.34) Adjusted EBITDA 1 of $16 million Repaid $57 million of debt, supported by proceeds from the sale of Ocean Bio-Chem Holdings, Inc. ("OBCI") OneWater Marine Inc. (NASDAQ: ONEW) (“OneWater” or the “Company”) today announced results for its fiscal second quarter ended March 31, 2026. “Our second quarter was highlighted by continued improvement in boat margins and a significant reduction in leverage,” said Austin Singleton, Executive Chairman of OneWater. “Margin expansion reflects the benefits of a more focused portfolio and the deliberate actions taken to reduce complexity, optimize inventory, and manage costs.
